note: Direct carrier billing (m-platba / premium SMS). The link inspector stops before any hop (other than the scanned URL itself) to an operator or billing host, marks the inspection incomplete and shows csq.billing_gateway. Reaching such a host is a consequence, not fraud evidence.

patterns.normalization: Deaccent + casefold; keep original spans for display.

promotionRule: Deceptive subscription (3.2, floor 80) requires ALL of: recurrence (price+interval within 40 chars in the same offer block, or a subscription match), activation (signup form with phone/OTP input + submit in the same offer, or an activation match), and independent deception (menu/parking promise replaced by an unrelated subscription, a 'zdarma' claim not clearly disclosed as a trial, or evidenced impersonation). A clearly disclosed free trial never qualifies.
